title: The market this autumn, in four numbers
excerpt: How long homes took to sell, how close to the asking price, and which streets moved fastest. Our own figures, not a headline.
content:
Headlines about the housing market describe a country. You are selling one house on one street. These are our own figures for the homes we sold between September and November.

  • Seven weeks, on average, from listing to an accepted offer
  • 97% of the asking price achieved
  • Four viewings before an offer, on average
  • One sale in five agreed before the first open day

What it means if you are selling

Price it honestly and the first three weeks do most of the work. The homes that took longest were the ones that started too high and came down.
